sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Monitor:

| Metric | What it tells you |
| --- | --- |
| Timeout rate | How often requests exceed deadlines |
| Retry count | How many repeated attempts occur |
| Duplicate transaction count | Repeated side effects |
| API latency | How long services take |
| p95/p99 latency | Slowest portion of requests |
| Idempotency conflicts | Repeated keys or conflicting payloads |
| Request correlation ID | Which requests belong to the same workflow |

steps.label: Symptom
steps.narration: Users or monitors report a visible failure signal.

steps.label: Detect
steps.narration: Correlate logs, metrics, and traces to identify the failure mode.

steps.label: Isolate
steps.narration: Contain blast radius so healthy traffic keeps working.

steps.label: Mitigate
steps.narration: Apply retries, fallbacks, degrade modes, or kill-switches.

steps.label: Recover
steps.narration: Fix the root cause, verify recovery, and capture a runbook update.
